hook.text: Node.js gave JavaScript a server. Express gave that server a framework.

buildup.text: Express was tiny — just middleware and routing. Everything else was your choice.

discovery.text: Its minimalism attracted developers who wanted control over every architectural decision.

twist.text: That freedom was also its weakness. No two Express apps look the same, making onboarding hard.

climax.text: Express became the most popular Node.js framework precisely because it dictated nothing.
